title: Stop this fake bhakti
description:
Bhakti in India is turning into a circus online. The Kanwar Yatra, once a spiritual journey, now looks like a DJ party on wheels—complete with dancers, disco lights, and viral reels. Meanwhile, videos of “Kanhaiyya Lalla” giving exams or idols made to perform stunts go viral in the name of devotion.

This isn’t faith—it’s fake internet bhakti, where spirituality is sidelined for views, clout, and money. What was meant to be sacred is now reduced to entertainment content.

In this video, we expose how blind devotion and internet drama are cheapening India’s spiritual traditions.
